messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to chat with me today about the enhancements to the university student portal. To start off, could you share what the main goals are for these enhancements? What are you hoping to achieve with the new features?

Hey! No problem, happy to be here. So, honestly, I just want the portal to be easier to use. The timetable is a bit of a mess right now, and I think it could really help if I could customize it a bit, like maybe color-code my classes or hide the ones that are canceled. That would make it way more manageable.

Also, it’d be great to get notifications when grades come out, like, I don’t want to keep checking all the time. And I think there should be a way for us to give feedback on our modules after the term ends, you know? Just to let them know what worked and what didn’t.

Thanks for sharing that! It sounds like personalizing the timetable would really help you manage your classes better. Just to clarify, when you mention color-coding or hiding canceled classes, how would you like that to work? Can you give me an example of what you envision?

Yeah, sure! So, like, if I could pick a color for each module, that would be super helpful. For example, I could have all my math classes in blue and my history ones in green. That way, when I look at my timetable, I can see everything at a glance and it doesn’t all just blend together.

And for hiding canceled classes, maybe there could be a button or something I could click to make those disappear. It’s annoying to see classes that aren’t happening, so if I could just tidy up my view, that would be awesome!

Got it! So you’d like to choose specific colors for each module to help distinguish them, and you'd also want a button to hide any canceled classes for a cleaner view. That makes a lot of sense! 

Now, regarding the grade notifications, could you explain a bit more about what kind of notifications you're looking for? What would you like to be notified about specifically?

Sure! I’d just want to know whenever a new grade gets posted for any of my modules. Like, if a lecturer puts up grades, I’d love to get a quick notification, maybe like a pop-up or an email, so I don’t have to keep checking the portal. 

Just something simple that tells me, “Hey, your grade for [Module Name] is up!” That way, I can stay on top of things without stressing about missing any updates.

That sounds really helpful! So you’d like to receive notifications via pop-ups or emails whenever a new grade is posted for any of your modules, with a message indicating which module the grade is for. 

Now, about the module feedback system, could you describe how you imagine that working? What kind of feedback would you like to give, and how do you think it should be submitted?

Yeah, so for the feedback, I think it would be good to have some kind of form we could fill out after the term ends. I’d want to be able to share what I thought about the module, like how good the content was, if the teaching was effective, and what resources were helpful or not.

It’d be nice if it was really straightforward, like just a few questions or maybe some rating things, so it doesn’t take too long to do. I’m not sure how exactly it should be submitted, but maybe just a button on the portal or something that takes us straight to the feedback form after grades are out. That way, we can share our thoughts without it feeling like a hassle.

Thanks for explaining that! So you’d like a simple feedback form available after the term, where you can rate and share your thoughts on the module's content, teaching effectiveness, and helpful resources. It sounds like you want it to be easy to access, perhaps through a button on the portal after grades are posted. 

To summarize what we've discussed so far:
1. Personalised timetables with color-coding for each module and an option to hide canceled classes.
2. Notifications via pop-ups or emails when new grades are posted for modules.
3. A straightforward feedback form available after the term for sharing thoughts on modules, with a button for easy access.

Are there any limitations or restrictions we should consider while implementing these features?

Um, I haven't really thought about any limitations or restrictions. I just want it to work well and be easy to use! I guess as long as it doesn’t mess with how we log in or anything like that, that would be fine. But I’m not really sure about the behind-the-scenes stuff. I just hope it all comes together smoothly!

That makes sense! So as long as the enhancements don’t disrupt the existing login process and are easy to use, that should be fine. 

Just to confirm, here are the requirements we've gathered:
1. Personalised timetables with color-coding for each module and an option to hide canceled classes.
2. Notifications via pop-ups or emails when new grades are posted for modules.
3. A straightforward feedback form available after the term for sharing thoughts on modules, with a button for easy access.
4. Ensure that the login process remains unchanged and everything works smoothly.

Thank you for your input! I think we have a good starting point. 

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
